title: Paintings Need Glass (PNG)
description: Client-side mod that adds support for transparent painting textures.
body:
Paintings Need Glass (PNG) is a client-side mod for Minecraft which adds support for transparent painting textures.

These textures can be used through resource packs, data packs or other mods.

The mod can be toggled in-game with the command `/paintingsneedglass toggle` (v1.1.0 +).

Rendering of painting's side textures can be toggled with `/paintingsneedglass togglesides` (v1.1.0 +).
